affiliations.date_precision: The 1929 yearbook says Muschamp was teaching French and German while continuing his language studies; the exact start and end dates are not stated.
affiliations.research_notes: The rare indexed name and middle initial probably match Percy Lawrence Herbert Muschamp. This is earlier documented employment only; neither immediacy nor a Yale relationship type is inferred.

affiliations.date_precision: The Michigan Supreme Court opinion says he sold his grocery in early 1943 while preparing for Army induction; it does not give the business name or exact sale date.
affiliations.research_notes: Exact distinctive name, middle initial, and matching 1943-1945 Army chronology support the identity. The grocery is the last documented civilian work before Army service, not an asserted immediate OSS predecessor.
